steps.english: IF file "wd" column "Note" contains "50%_off*" OR file "wd" column "Code" does not start with "A" or "B" AND file "wd" column "Code" ends with "Z" THEN display text response "Check code" in new column "Error Message", appended with separator "; ".

=IF(OR(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("50%_off~*", [@[Note]])), AND(NOT(LEFT([@[Code]], 1)="A"), NOT(LEFT([@[Code]], 1)="B"), RIGHT([@[Code]], 1)="Z")), IF([@[Error Message]]="", "Check code", [@[Error Message]]&"; "&"Check code"), [@[Error Message]])

CASE WHEN [Note] LIKE '%50[%][_]off*%' OR (([Code] NOT LIKE 'A%' AND [Code] NOT LIKE 'B%') AND [Code] LIKE '%Z') THEN CONCAT_WS('; ', NULLIF([Error Message], ''), 'Check code') ELSE [Error Message] END AS [Error Message]

mask = df["Note"].fillna("").astype(str).str.contains("50%_off*", case=False, regex=False) | ((~(df["Code"].fillna("").astype(str).str.lower().str.startswith("a")) & ~(df["Code"].fillna("").astype(str).str.lower().str.startswith("b"))) & df["Code"].fillna("").astype(str).str.lower().str.endswith("z"))
df["Error Message"] = df.get("Error Message", "")
existing = df.loc[mask, "Error Message"].fillna("").astype(str)
df.loc[mask, "Error Message"] = existing.where(existing == "", existing + "; ") + "Check code"

-- Step 3: Reference Source

step_3 AS (
  SELECT * FROM [wd] AS [wd]
),

-- Step 4: IF / THEN
-- IF file "wd" column "Status" is equal to "T" or "R" THEN display record.
-- Note: Display - Keep only rows that match this condition.
step_4 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM step_3
  WHERE [Status] IN ('T', 'R')
),

-- Step 5: IF / THEN
-- IF file "wd" column "Plan" is blank/null AND file "wd" column "Manager" is not equal to file "sap" column "PERNR" THEN do not display record.
-- Note: Do Not Display - Keep only rows that do not match this condition.
step_5 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM step_4
  WHERE NOT (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM([Plan])), '') IS NULL AND [Manager] <> [PERNR])
),

-- Step 6: IF / THEN
-- IF file "wd" column "Note" contains "50%_off*" OR file "wd" column "Code" does not start with "A" or "B" AND file "wd" column "Code" ends with "Z" THEN display text response "Check code" in new column "Error Message", appended with separator "; ".
step_6 AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN [Note] LIKE '%50[%][_]off*%' OR (([Code] NOT LIKE 'A%' AND [Code] NOT LIKE 'B%') AND [Code] LIKE '%Z') THEN CONCAT_WS('; ', NULLIF(CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(4000)), ''), 'Check code') ELSE CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(4000)) END AS [Error Message]
  FROM step_5
),

-- Step 7: IF / THEN
-- IF file "wd" column "A" is equal to "1" AND file "wd" column "B" is greater than "040" OR file "wd" column "C" is equal to "3" AND:
--   • file "wd" column "D" is less than or equal to "4" OR
--   • file "wd" column "E" does not contain "x" THEN set "Salary Check" value to file "wd" column "Salary" value.
step_7 AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN ([A] = '1' AND [B] > 40) OR ([C] = '3' AND ([D] <= 4 OR [E] NOT LIKE '%x%')) THEN [Salary] END AS [Salary Check]
  FROM step_6
),

-- Step 8: IF / THEN
-- IF file "wd" column "Pay" is greater than [Hours] * 20 THEN set "Overpay" value to file "wd" column "Pay" minus file "wd" column "Hours", then round to the nearest whole number.
step_8 AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN [Hours] * 20 THEN ROUND([Pay] - [Hours], 0) END AS [Overpay]
  FROM step_7
),

-- Step 9: IF / THEN
-- IF file "wd" column "Country" is not blank/null THEN set "Country Short" value to the first 2 characters of file "wd" column "Country".
step_9 AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM([Country])), '') IS NOT NULL THEN LEFT([Country], 2) END AS [Country Short]
  FROM step_8
),

-- TODO (skipped) Step 10: IF / THEN
-- IF file "wd" column "Region" is equal to "EMEA" THEN Route to the EMEA review queue.

-- Developer Logic:

-- Step 11: IF / THEN

step_11 AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN [Plan] = 'Bonus' THEN CONCAT_WS('||', NULLIF([Error Message], ''), 'Bonus plan') ELSE CONCAT_WS('||', NULLIF([Error Message], ''), 'Other plan') END AS [Error Message]
  FROM step_9
),

-- Step 11.1 (ELSE branch): Logic Step

step_12_1 AS (

  FROM step_11
  WHERE [Grade] = 'A'
),

-- IF file "wd" column "Active" is equal to "Yes" THEN display record.
-- Note: Display - Keep only rows that match this condition.
step_13 AS (
  SELECT *

  WHERE [Active] = 'Yes'

-- Step 13.1 (THEN branch): Create Column

# IF THEN conditions and actions - Python (pandas) audit script
# Exported from ATLAS Align on 2026-11-16. 18 enabled steps; disabled steps are left out.
# Generated from Developer Logic. Review the code and test it on sample data before relying on the results.
#
# TODO: 2 steps could not be converted and are skipped below:
#   - Step 10: THEN action is free text and is not in the formulas: Route to the EMEA review queue
#   - Step 12: The formulas mark rows that match this condition.
#
# Review:
#   - Steps 11.1, 12.1, 13.1, 13.2 are nested under another step. Their code runs on every row; add the parent step's condition if they should only apply to the parent's matching rows.
#
# Before running: fill in SOURCE_PATHS and OUTPUT_PATH below.
# Requires pandas and numpy, plus openpyxl to read or write Excel files.

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Required variables: set these paths before running
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Source files to read, one per source the audit uses (.csv, .txt, .xlsx, .xls).
SOURCE_PATHS = {
    "wd": "",
    "sap": "",
}

# File to write the audit results to (.csv or .xlsx).
OUTPUT_PATH = ""

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reading and writing files
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
EXCEL_EXTENSIONS = {".xlsx", ".xlsm", ".xls"}
TEXT_EXTENSIONS = {".csv", ".txt"}


def check_paths():
    """Stops with a message when a required path is blank or a file is missing."""
    blank = [f"SOURCE_PATHS[{name!r}]" for name, path in SOURCE_PATHS.items() if not path]
    if not OUTPUT_PATH:
        blank.append("OUTPUT_PATH")
    if blank:
        sys.exit("Set these paths at the top of the script: " + ", ".join(blank))
    missing = [path for path in SOURCE_PATHS.values() if not Path(path).is_file()]
    if missing:
        sys.exit("These source files were not found: " + ", ".join(missing))


def read_source(path):
    """Reads a source file, choosing the reader from its extension."""
    extension = Path(path).suffix.lower()
    if extension in EXCEL_EXTENSIONS:
        return pd.read_excel(path)
    if extension in TEXT_EXTENSIONS:
        return pd.read_csv(path)
    sys.exit(f"{path}: use a .csv, .txt, .xlsx or .xls file.")


def write_output(df, path):
    """Writes the results, choosing the writer from the file extension."""
    extension = Path(path).suffix.lower()
    if extension in EXCEL_EXTENSIONS:
        df.to_excel(path, index=False)
    elif extension in TEXT_EXTENSIONS:
        df.to_csv(path, index=False)
    else:
        sys.exit(f"{path}: OUTPUT_PATH must end in .csv or .xlsx.")


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Audit logic
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def run_audit(sources):
    """Runs the audit steps in order and returns the results."""
    # Step 1: Reference wd
    # Reference source file "WD_Workers" as "wd":
    df = sources["wd"].copy()

    # Step 2: Reference sap
    # Reference source file "SAP_HI0256" as "sap":
    df = sources["sap"].copy()

    # Step 3: Reference Source
    # Reference source file "wd" as "wd":
    df = sources["wd"].copy()

    # Step 4: IF / THEN
    # IF file "wd" column "Status" is equal to "T" or "R" THEN display record.
    # Note: Display - Keep only rows that match this condition.
    mask = df["Status"].isin(["T", "R"])
    df = df[mask]

    # Step 5: IF / THEN
    # IF file "wd" column "Plan" is blank/null AND file "wd" column "Manager" is not equal to file "sap" column "PERNR" THEN do not display record.
    # Note: Do Not Display - Keep only rows that do not match this condition.
    mask = df["Plan"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().eq("") & (df["Manager"] != df["PERNR"])
    df = df[~mask]

    # Step 6: IF / THEN
    # IF file "wd" column "Note" contains "50%_off*" OR file "wd" column "Code" does not start with "A" or "B" AND file "wd" column "Code" ends with "Z" THEN display text response "Check code" in new column "Error Message", appended with separator "; ".
    mask = df["Note"].fillna("").astype(str).str.contains("50%_off*", case=False, regex=False) | ((~(df["Code"].fillna("").astype(str).str.lower().str.startswith("a")) & ~(df["Code"].fillna("").astype(str).str.lower().str.startswith("b"))) & df["Code"].fillna("").astype(str).str.lower().str.endswith("z"))
    df["Error Message"] = df.get("Error Message", "")
    existing = df.loc[mask, "Error Message"].fillna("").astype(str)
    df.loc[mask, "Error Message"] = existing.where(existing == "", existing + "; ") + "Check code"

    # Step 7: IF / THEN
    # IF file "wd" column "A" is equal to "1" AND file "wd" column "B" is greater than "040" OR file "wd" column "C" is equal to "3" AND:
    #   • file "wd" column "D" is less than or equal to "4" OR
    #   • file "wd" column "E" does not contain "x" THEN set "Salary Check" value to file "wd" column "Salary" value.
    mask = ((df["A"] == "1") & (df["B"] > 40)) | ((df["C"] == "3") & ((df["D"] <= 4) | ~(df["E"].fillna("").astype(str).str.contains("x", case=False, regex=False))))
    df.loc[mask, "Salary Check"] = df["Salary"]

    # Step 8: IF / THEN
    # IF file "wd" column "Pay" is greater than [Hours] * 20 THEN set "Overpay" value to file "wd" column "Pay" minus file "wd" column "Hours", then round to the nearest whole number.
    mask = [Hours] * 20
    df.loc[mask, "Overpay"] = np.sign(df["Pay"] - df["Hours"]) * np.floor(np.abs(df["Pay"] - df["Hours"]) + 0.5)

    # Step 9: IF / THEN
    # IF file "wd" column "Country" is not blank/null THEN set "Country Short" value to the first 2 characters of file "wd" column "Country".
    mask = df["Country"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().ne("")
    df.loc[mask, "Country Short"] = df["Country"].astype("string").str[:2]

    # TODO (skipped) Step 10: IF / THEN
    # IF file "wd" column "Region" is equal to "EMEA" THEN Route to the EMEA review queue.
    # Reason: THEN action is free text and is not in the formulas: Route to the EMEA review queue
    # Developer Logic:
    # mask = df["Region"] == "EMEA"

    # Step 11: IF / THEN
    # IF file "wd" column "Plan" is equal to "Bonus" THEN display text response "Bonus plan" in new column "Error Message".
    mask = df["Plan"] == "Bonus"
    df["Error Message"] = df.get("Error Message", "")
    existing = df.loc[mask, "Error Message"].fillna("").astype(str)
    df.loc[mask, "Error Message"] = existing.where(existing == "", existing + "||") + "Bonus plan"
    df["Error Message"] = df.get("Error Message", "")
    existing = df.loc[~mask, "Error Message"].fillna("").astype(str)
    df.loc[~mask, "Error Message"] = existing.where(existing == "", existing + "||") + "Other plan"

    # Step 11.1 (ELSE branch): Logic Step
    # ELSE display text response "Other plan" in new column "Error Message".
    # ELSE (Step 12): included in the Step 12 formulas.

    # TODO (skipped) Step 12: IF / THEN
    # IF file "wd" column "Grade" is equal to "A":
    # Reason: The formulas mark rows that match this condition.
    # Developer Logic:
    # mask = df["Grade"] == "A"

    # Step 12.1 (ELSE branch): Logic Step
    # ELSE do not display record.
    # Note: ELSE Do Not Display - Keep only rows that match the parent IF.
    mask = df["Grade"] == "A"
    df = df[mask]

    # Step 13: IF / THEN
    # IF file "wd" column "Active" is equal to "Yes" THEN display record.
    # Note: Display - Keep only rows that match this condition.
    mask = df["Active"] == "Yes"
    df = df[mask]

    # Step 13.1 (THEN branch): Create Column
    # Create new column "Checked" and set value to "Y".
    df["Checked"] = "Y"

    # Step 13.2 (THEN branch): IF / THEN
    # IF file "wd" column "Type" is equal to "FT" THEN do not display record.
    # Note: Do Not Display - Keep only rows that do not match this condition.
    mask = df["Type"] == "FT"
    df = df[~mask]

    # Step 14: IF / THEN
    # IF file "wd" column "Active" is equal to "Yes" THEN do not display record.
    # Note: Do Not Display - Keep only rows that do not match this condition.
    mask = df["Active"] == "Yes"
    df = df[~mask]

    return df


def main():
    check_paths()
    sources = {name: read_source(path) for name, path in SOURCE_PATHS.items()}
    results = run_audit(sources)
    write_output(results, OUTPUT_PATH)
    print(f"Wrote {len(results):,} rows to {OUTPUT_PATH}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
